parts.question: Compare adverse-event evidence in hn-204 and HN-402 for nausea

result.answer: In HN-204, the treatment-emergent adverse event nausea occurred in 12.7% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and it was not serious [E1]. In HN-402, nausea occurred in 14.1% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and it was not serious [E2]. The treatment % for nausea in HN-402 was +1.4 points higher than in HN-204, while the control % remained the same with a +0.0 points difference [E4]. Nausea was the highest treatment % in both HN-204 (12.7%) and HN-402 (14.1%) [E4].
